evals.prompt: Add a tool-call mediation endpoint that denies invalid params and forwards only allowed calls. What statuses and order apply?
evals.expected_output: Decide-audit-forward: deny maps to 403, upstream failures map to 502, audit is best-effort and never flips the decision.

evals.prompt: The proxy needs observability without affecting routing. Which counters and endpoint apply?
evals.expected_output: ProxyMetrics counters (allow, deny, mediator_errors, upstream_ok, upstream_failures, audit_write_failures) exposed as JSON at GET /metrics; counters never affect decisions.
